const code = `
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,subprocess,sys
sys.path.insert(0,"tools")
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.lint import AT_TOKEN_RE, MARKUP_RE
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
root=Path(".")
task=root/".ai/task/repair-w46-20260927"
baseline_path=task/"baseline/tome-orcs.lua"
assert baseline_path.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"]), "task baseline differs from HEAD"
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest()))
base=loader.load_path(baseline_path,logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
cur=loader.load_path(root/"tome-orcs.lua",logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
ws=json.loads((task/"WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["items"]
assert len(ws)==20 and len(base)==len(cur)==3904,(len(ws),len(base),len(cur))
allowed={(x["section"],x["source"],x["source_tag"]):x for x in ws}
assert len(allowed)==20
ph=re.compile(r"%[-+ #0]*\\d*(?:\\.\\d+)?[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%]")
trail=lambda v:[len(x)-len(x.rstrip(" \\t")) for x in v.split("\\n")]
changed=[]
target_record=None
for before,after in zip(base,cur):
    left={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!="line"}
    right={k:v for k,v in after.items() if k!="line"}
    if left==right:
        continue
    key=(before["section"],before["source"],before["source_tag"])
    assert key in allowed,("unscoped",key)
    item=allowed[key]
    assert before["target"]==item["target_preimage"],("preimage",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert {k:v for k,v in left.items() if k!="target"}=={k:v for k,v in right.items() if k!="target"},("non-target",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    source,target=after["source"],after["target"]
    assert source.count("\\n")==target.count("\\n"),("LF",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert [len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in source.split("\\n")]==[len(x)-len(x.lstrip("\\t")) for x in target.split("\\n")],("TAB",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert [i for i,x in enumerate(source.split("\\n")) if not x.strip()]==[i for i,x in enumerate(target.split("\\n")) if not x.strip()],("blank",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert source.endswith("\\n")==target.endswith("\\n"),("terminal LF",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert ph.findall(source)==ph.findall(target),("placeholder",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert MARKUP_RE.findall(source)==MARKUP_RE.findall(target),("markup",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(source)==AT_TOKEN_RE.findall(target),("at-token",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    assert all(a<=b for a,b in zip(trail(target),trail(before["target"]))),("new trailing whitespace",item["entry_revision_identity"])
    changed.append(item["entry_revision_identity"])
    if item["entry_revision_identity"].startswith("f466031dbb"):
        target_record=after
assert len(changed)==20,len(changed)
assert set(changed)=={x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in ws}
assert target_record is not None
assert target_record["target"].count("突然感觉到他的骨甲在一群无可言喻地强大的七彩龙的吐息风暴中解体")==1
assert "突然感觉到他的骨盾在一群无可言喻地强大的七彩龙的吐息风暴中解体" not in target_record["target"]
assert target_record["target"].count("异形触手")==2
print(json.dumps({"baseline":"HEAD","records_before":len(base),"records_after":len(cur),"changed_targets":len(changed),"non_target_changes":0,"workset_exact":True,"lf_tab_blank_terminal":True,"no_new_trailing_whitespace":True,"placeholders_markup":True,"confirmed_bone_armor_fixed":True,"refuted_weirdling_beast_unchanged":True},ensure_ascii=False))
`;
const quoted = "'" + code.replace(/'/g, "'\\''") + "'";
const calls = [
  tools.exec_command({cmd:`python3 -B -c ${quoted}`,workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我用项目的 manifest LuaJIT loader 对 HEAD 和冻结 20 条 WORKSET 执行有界语义验证吗？"}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我运行要求的 strict lint 吗？","prefix_rule":["python3","-B","tools/i18n","lint"]}),
  tools.exec_command({cmd:"git diff --check",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",yield_time_ms:30000,max_output_tokens:12000,sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"允许我运行要求的 git diff 空白检查吗？","prefix_rule":["git","diff","--check"]})
];
const rs=await Promise.all(calls);
rs.forEach((r,i)=>text(JSON.stringify({validation:i+1,exit_code:r.exit_code,output:r.output})));
